target_customer: Employers with high-volume and hourly hiring needs, such as retail and hospitality
problem: High-volume hiring is slow and biased. Humanly uses conversational AI to engage, screen and schedule candidates at scale.

founders.name: Prem Kumar
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder and CEO in HR Tech Feed (2021) and EdTechReview coverage.

founders.name: Andrew Gardner
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page without a bio.

founders.name: Bryan Leptich
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page without a bio.

competitors.name: Paradox (Olivia)
competitors.what: Conversational AI assistant for recruiting, screening and scheduling
competitors.traction_then: Olivia launched in 2016; large enterprise customer base per its press release
competitors.funding_then: $40M Series B led by Brighton Park Capital in May 2020

technical_complexity.rationale: Chatbot screening and scheduling with ATS integrations at launch; standard NLP engineering plus hard integration work with many applicant tracking systems.

defensibility.rationale: Chatbots were easy to copy and Paradox was far ahead. Integrations and hiring data add modest lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Paradox grew to unicorn valuation in December 2021; Humanly instead became an acquirer, buying Teamable (2024) and several firms in 2025 and 2026.

market_need_then: The company describes high-volume hiring as inefficient and biased. No third party dated spend data was found for 2020.

branding.domain_note: Started as humanly.io, still uses humanly.io.

identity.voice_and_tone: Human connection at scale, mission language about fairness and quality conversations.

branding.community_and_virality: No community or merch evidence found; recognised in trade lists of HR chatbots per a 2021 press item.

brand_strength.rationale: The name fits the human centered pitch but is a common word, and sources show vendor comparison pages rather than brand-level press.

pivots.to: End to end AI hiring platform built through acquisitions
pivots.why: Company stated aim to cover engage, screen, interview, CRM and ATS in one system.

outcome_analysis: Humanly raised small early rounds and a $4.2 million raise in 2021, then a $12 million Series A led by Drive Capital in 2023 and a reported $25 million Series B in 2026. It moved from a chatbot into a broader platform by acquiring Teamable and other firms. Competitor Paradox was far ahead at founding, so the roll-up strategy was its route to scale.
notes: The $800K seed comes from a headline in search results; the page returned no content and no date, so date is null. GeekWire's 2023 article returned 403, so the Series A amount and lead come from search summaries naming GeekWire and EdTechReview. Series B is from pulse.bot and PitchBook per search summaries; Caplight dates it April 2026 so only the year is given. Aggregators list a $7M round in May 2025 and totals from $20M to $49M, which are unverified. YC lists Winter 2020; one 2021 article says launched July 2019. Acquisitions in 2024 to 2026 are from search summaries.
